_doc: Shots cut from M1, and the retime that follows. A cut is not a render note: removing a shot moves every shot after it, moves every caption with them, and changes the film's length. lib/cut.js applies it in one place so the picture and the subtitle script cannot disagree about where they are.
_frozen: data/ is untouched. v1.0.6 stays byte-identical to the package; the decision lives here with its reason and the name behind it.
why: The director, 2026-09-23: the film opens on 01-02 - the sage walking up the aisle - with 'A sage came to Ayodhyā.' on it. That caption was already 01-02's; 01-01 carried no narration at all. The empty hall was 2.6 s of nothing before the film starts, and starting on the arrival is the stronger open.
sound: The entry conch stays, before the new first frame. It is the session's opening signature and belongs to the film, not to the shot that used to be under it - see direction/m1-sound.md.
